Launch or list built-in RDesk showcase demo applications

Source: R/cli.R
rdesk_demo.Rd

Lists or launches the showcase desktop applications bundled with RDesk:

cars

CarsAnalyser — Automotive performance and regression telemetry workbench.

studio

Data Intelligence Studio — Clinical trial explorer and dataset profiling workbench.

starter

RDeskStarterWorkbench — Freshly scaffolded rdesk_create_app() starter workbench.

Also powers the rdesk demo command-line interface.

Usage

rdesk_demo(name = NULL, theme = "dark", debug = FALSE, detach = FALSE)

Arguments

name

Optional character string naming the demo to launch: "cars", "studio", or "starter". When NULL (default), prints the catalog of available demos and returns it invisibly.

theme

Theme used for the "starter" demo: "light", "dark", or "system". Default "dark".

debug

Logical. If TRUE, sets RDESK_DEBUG=1 to enable webview developer tools and verbose IPC logging. Default FALSE.

detach

Logical. If TRUE, launches the demo in the background and returns immediately. Default FALSE.

Value

When name is NULL, returns a data.frame describing the available demos invisibly. Otherwise returns the result of rdesk_run(), invisibly.

Examples

demos <- rdesk_demo()
#> [RDesk] Available built-in demos:
#>   cars     - CarsAnalyser (Automotive Performance & Regression Telemetry Workbench)
#>   studio   - Data Intelligence Studio (Clinical Trial Explorer & Dataset Profiler)
#>   starter  - RDeskStarterWorkbench (rdesk_create_app() Starter Template)
#> Run a demo with: RDesk::rdesk_demo('cars')  or  rdesk demo cars
print(demos$name)
#> [1] "cars"    "studio"  "starter"
